title: A ticket price
description:
Work out a ticket price with `if` and `switch`.

```
Age: 15
Day (1=Mon .. 7=Sun): 2
Price: 4.50
```
hints: `case 6: case 7: price += 1.0; break;` lets two cases share code (lesson 1.05).
requirements: Tuesdays (day 2) take 2.00 off, but not below 3.00. Weekends (6 and 7) add 1.00.
Use a `switch` on the day; an unknown day prints `Unknown day`.
stretch: Read several tickets until age 0 and print the total.
